response.query: What minimal data infrastructure, staffing roles, and budget are required to run a 6–12 month pilot covering instrument pilot, data collection, analysis, dashboards, and community engagement?
response.answer: Minimal data infrastructure includes basic data collection tools, a simple database, and analysis software. Staffing roles: project manager, data analyst, and community liaison. Budget: $100,000 for 6-12 months.

results.title: The Legacy of the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic ...
results.content: **However, levels of physical activity of the population remain insufficient in many countries, including France.** The World Health Organisation recommends that adults perform at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic physical activity, or at least 75 minutes of physical activity per week, and limit the amount of time spent being sedentary [(OECD/WHO, 2023[7])](/en/publications/the-legacy-of-the-paris-2024-olympic-and-paralympic-games_d7938b7f-en/full-report/inclusive-games-coming-together-to-leverage-sport-for-health-education-and-inclusion_877f4a81.html#OEC23_7ee90f98bc). By 2024, the programme has accredited some 11 000 schools and institutions [(Ministère de l'Éducation Nationale et de la Jeunesse, n.d.[9])](/en/publications/the-legacy-of-the-paris-2024-olympic-and-paralympic-games_d7938b7f-en/full-report/inclusive-games-coming-together-to-leverage-sport-for-health-education-and-inclusion_877f4a81.html#Min24_7ee90f98bc), strengthened connections with local sports clubs, and inspired increased participation in sports activities, fostering healthier and more active lifestyles while embedding Olympic ideals in education and broader social contexts (see detailed case study later in the chapter).
